newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African police smash ring selling army weapons.
newsitem.headline: S.African police smash ring selling army weapons.

text.p: South African police smashed a ring of gun-runners selling assault rifles and army pistols to gangsters and rivals in a conflict among taxi firms, a senior policeman said on Thursday.
Police arrested eight suspects in a raid in two suburbs on the outskirts of Pretoria.
Captain Stan Visser, commander of the police firearm unit, said undercover police agents bought 11 AK-47 assault rifles and 163 pistols from the syndicate over the past year.
"The members sold guns to anyone who wanted guns," he said.
Many of the weapons were defence force stock still in the packaging.
Police said it was inconceivable that the army weapons had ended up in the hands of the gun-runners without inside help, but they did not elaborate.
Hundreds of people have been killed in fighting among rival taxi drivers' groups around South Africa in recent years, mostly in disputes over passengers and overcrowded routes.
